parts.text: Calculate my 1-Rep Max if I benched 225 lbs for 5 reps, and give me my 90% and 80% working weight recommendations.
Based on 225 lbs for 5 reps, the estimated 1RM is approximately 260-262 lbs (Epley formula: 225 * (1 + 5/30) = 262.5 lbs). 90% is ~235 lbs and 80% is ~210 lbs.
Log my deadlift workout today: 3 sets of 5 reps at 315 lbs with good form.
Successfully logged Deadlift: 3 sets x 5 reps @ 315 lbs for a total volume load of 4,725 lbs.
How do I perform a Romanian Deadlift correctly? Focus on hip hinge cues.

To perform a Romanian Deadlift (RDL): Maintain a soft knee bend, initiate by pushing your hips straight back in a hinge motion, keep the barbell close to your shins, keep your spine neutral, and drive through the hips to return to standing.
What does exercise science recommend as the optimal weekly set volume per muscle group for hypertrophy?

Evidence-based guidelines indicate that optimal hypertrophy volume is generally 10 to 20 hard sets per muscle group per week (Optimal Volume, MEV to MRV), with 2 to 3 minutes of rest between compound sets.
I need a budget-friendly meal plan for muscle building. My daily budget is 150 rupees (₹150 INR) and I am a pure vegetarian. What should I eat to get enough protein?

For a ₹150/day pure vegetarian muscle-building diet, focus on high protein-to-cost staples: Soya Chunks (₹0.29/g protein), Roasted Chana Sattu (Desi Whey), curd/dahi, and paneer. This delivers 100g+ protein across 5 meals within your ₹150 budget.
How do I load a 140 kg barbell for deadlifts on a standard 20kg Olympic bar?
For 140 kg total on a 20 kg Olympic barbell, load 60 kg per side: two 25 kg plates and one 10 kg plate on each sleeve. Always secure with Olympic collars.
What is my lifter rank and strength ratio if I weigh 70 kg and my lifts are Deadlift 180 kg, Squat 140 kg, and Bench Press 100 kg?

With a 70 kg bodyweight and 420 kg total (180kg deadlift + 140kg squat + 100kg bench), your strength-to-weight ratio is 6.0x BW. You achieve Level 6: Diamond Titan status with badges like Century Squatter and 2x BW Deadlift Club.
How to perform bicep curls with dumbells? Provide the correct form, movement execution, body posture, and how many reps to do.

To perform dumbbell bicep curls with proper form: (1) Body Posture: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, chest high, shoulders packed back and down, core braced, and elbows pinned against your ribcage. (2) Movement Execution: Curl weights upward while actively supinating wrists (turning palms toward the ceiling) without swinging torso or using hip momentum. Squeeze biceps for 1 second at the top, then lower under control over 2-3 seconds to a full bottom stretch. (3) Reps & Sets: For hypertrophy and muscle growth, perform 3-4 sets of 8-12 reps; for endurance, perform 3 sets of 12-15 reps.
